```{r}
library(readr)
data <- read_csv("full-names-data-nice.csv")
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
data %>%
  filter(name == "Karen", sex == "F") %>%
  summarize(total = n())
```
```{r}
source("karen-helper-fns.R")
```

```{r}
us_karen <- data %>%
  filter(country == "US", name == "Karen", sex %in% c("Girl", "F")) %>%
  arrange(year)
```

```{r}
england.wales_karen <- data %>%
  filter(country == "England/Wales", name == "Karen", sex %in% c("Girl", "F")) %>%
  arrange(year)
```

```{r}
scotland_karen <- data %>%
  filter(country == "Scotland", name == "Karen", sex %in% c("Girl", "F")) %>%
  arrange(year)
```

```{r}
NI_karen <- data %>%
  filter(country == "Northern Ireland", name == "Karen", sex %in% c("Girl", "F")) %>%
  arrange(year)
```


```{r}
#England / Wales
helperCorLagKaren(england.wales_karen,20,us_karen)
```

```{r}
#Scotland
helperCorLagKaren(us_karen,20,scotland_karen)
```

```{r}
#NI 
helperCorLagKaren(us_karen,20,NI_karen)
```
